Help:
Available commands:
/update    - check and update ffmpeg and yt-dlp
/cookie    - upload cookies for a site (e.g. /cookie youtube)
/cookies   - show cookie status of all sites
/status    - show runtime status and versions
/language  - choose your interface language
/config    - view/change bot configuration
/access    - manage whitelist users/channels
/help      - show this help

Send a video/music link directly to start a download.
AuthRequired: The target site requires sign-in/authentication (e.g. YouTube bot check). Upload cookies for this site via /cookie and retry.

ModeChoice: This link contains video and audio. Choose a download mode:
CookieUsage:
Usage:
/cookie <site> - start uploading cookies for the site, then send the cookies file
/cookie <site> clear - delete cookies for the site
/cookies - show status of all sites

/config reset <Key> - restore install/default value
/config reset-all - clear all overrides
